items.label: Faster Performance & Smooth Multitasking
items.value: Powered by the Intel processor and 32GB DDR4 RAM, this laptop delivers smooth multitasking for work, school, and everyday tasks. The 2TB PCIe SSD provides fast boot times and quick file access, helping you stay productive throughout the day.

items.label: 15.6'' FHD Micro-Edge Display
items.value: Enjoy crisp visuals on the 15.6-inch Full HD (1920×1080) LED display with micro-edge bezels that maximize viewing space. The 250-nit brightness provides clear visibility for work, streaming, and browsing, offering a more immersive and comfortable experience.

items.label: Wi-Fi 6 & Multiple Connectivity Options
items.value: Stay connected with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 for faster and more stable wireless performance. Equipped with USB-A, USB-C, HDMI, RJ-45, SD card reader, and audio jack, this laptop easily connects to monitors, peripherals, and storage devices.

items.label: Full-Size Keyboard with Numeric Keypad
items.value: The full-size keyboard with an integrated numeric keypad provides a comfortable and efficient typing experience. Ideal for spreadsheets, accounting, data entry, and everyday productivity tasks, helping you work more accurately and efficiently.

items.label: Portable Design & All-Day Battery Life
items.value: Designed for mobility, this lightweight 3.84-lb laptop offers up to 9 hours of battery life, making it ideal for travel, remote learning, and on-the-go productivity. The 720p HD webcam ensures clear video calls for meetings, classes, and virtual collaboration.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Numeric Keypad, Spill Resistant
